mapper.sql: i.support_inquiry_id AS no, TO_CHAR(i.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS at, i.title, i.content AS body, i.status_code AS state

r.support_reply_id AS id, r.support_inquiry_id AS inquiry_no, TO_CHAR(r.created_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') AS at, r.content AS body, CASE WHEN r.updated_at > r.created_at + NUMTODSINTERVAL(1, 'SECOND') THEN TO_CHAR(r.updated_at, 'YYYY-MM-DD"T"HH24:MI:SS') END AS edited_at

SELECT , i.company_id, i.requester_employee_id, c.company_name AS company, c.company_code, e.employee_name AS name FROM support_inquiry i JOIN company c ON c.company_id = i.company_id JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = i.company_id AND e.employee_id = i.requester_employee_id
mapper.insert:
SELECT SQ_SUPPORT_INQUIRY.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO support_inquiry (support_inquiry_id, company_id, requester_employee_id, title, content) VALUES (#{no}, #{companyId}, #{employeeId}, #{title}, #{body, jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM support_inquiry i WHERE i.company_id = #{companyId} AND i.requester_employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.support_inquiry_id DESC

SELECT FROM support_reply r JOIN support_inquiry i ON i.company_id = r.company_id AND i.support_inquiry_id = r.support_inquiry_id WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} AND i.requester_employee_id = #{employeeId} ORDER BY r.support_reply_id

SELECT , e.employee_name AS name FROM support_inquiry i JOIN employee e ON e.company_id = i.company_id AND e.employee_id = i.requester_employee_id WHERE i.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.support_inquiry_id DESC
SELECT FROM support_reply r WHERE r.company_id = #{companyId} ORDER BY r.support_reply_id
ORDER BY i.created_at DESC, i.support_inquiry_id DESC
mapper.insert:
SELECT SQ_SUPPORT_REPLY.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO support_reply (support_reply_id, company_id, support_inquiry_id, author_account_id, content) VALUES (#{replyId}, #{companyId}, #{no}, #{authorAccountId}, #{body, jdbcType=CLOB})
mapper.update: UPDATE support_inquiry SET status_code = #{to}, operator_account_id = #{operatorAccountId}, updated_at = CAST(SYSTIMESTAMP AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' AS TIMESTAMP) WHERE support_inquiry_id = #{no} AND status_code = #{from}
